item.title: The 13 artists with the most No. 1 singles on the Billboard Hot 100
item.description: Bruno Mars joins the likes of Taylor Swift, Janet Jackson, The Beatles, and Michael Jackson with "I Just Might."

item.title: I've visited Las Vegas several times — the best part of every trip is less than an hour outside the city
item.description: I love taking a short drive from Las Vegas to Valley of Fire State Park for an easy day trip. It's got the best views and some of my favorite hikes.

item.title: I'm set to inherit my childhood home abroad. I'm not sure it will be worth the headache.
item.description: Parents think passing down their homes for their children to inherit is the ultimate reward. In this economy, it might not be.

item.title: Trump threatens Canada with 100% tariffs over Beijing trade deal: 'China will eat Canada alive'
item.description: The warning comes days after Mark Carney delivered a speech in Davos, where he opined on the changing face of global politics since Trump's election.

item.title: A 58-year-old whose job requires hours of sitting lost 75 pounds in 12 months with these simple changes
item.description: Jerry Clark says he's transformed his tastebuds, changed his portion sizes, and made fitness a non-negotiable.

item.title: I moved away from my family in my 30s. When I called crying, my dad dropped everything and came to see me.
item.description: Ruth Davis shares how moving her family to Los Angeles meant losing daily closeness with her dad and rethinking the cost of distance.

item.title: Minnesota Timberwolves postpone home game amid ICE protests
item.description: The NBA said the Minnesota Timberwolves home game against the Golden State Warriors on Saturday was postponed to prioritize safety.

item.title: You can bet on how much snow will fall in New York City this weekend
item.description: Prediction markets like Polymarket and Kalshi are allowing users to bet on how much snow will fall in New York City this weekend.

item.title: Thousands of flights canceled as massive winter storm slams the US. Here's what to do if your trip is impacted.
item.description: A severe winter storm has prompted US airlines to cancel flights, issue travel waivers, and advise passengers on refund and rebooking options.

item.title: ICE chaos is pushing Minnesota retailers to abandon business as usual: 'We've got to do what we can do right now'
item.description: "Retail feels totally different right now," one business owner said. "We've got to do what we can," said another.
